panels.title: Error Rate — Errors per Minute (LogQL)
panels.description: Counts ERROR-level log lines from shipping-service per minute. Spikes indicate failed shipment creation from order-placed events, carrier API timeouts, or geo-lookup failures.

panels.title: Shipment Status & Tracking Event Logs (LogQL)
panels.description: Counts shipping-service log lines related to shipment state transitions and tracking events over 5 m, grouped by log level. WARN-level entries indicate delayed or stuck shipments requiring manual intervention.

panels.title: Correlation ID Trace — Shipment Request Chains (LogQL)
panels.description: Streams shipping-service log lines carrying a correlationId. Enables tracing a single order-placed event through shipment creation, carrier assignment, and status update notifications.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate — Requests/s per Endpoint (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metric: http_server_requests_seconds_count | Layer 2 – Label: job=shipping-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: rate → sum by uri. Shows which shipping endpoints (create, tracking, nearby lookup) are under the most load.

panels.title: HTTP Latency Percentiles — P50 / P95 / P99 (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metric: http_server_requests_seconds_bucket | Layer 2 – Label: job=shipping-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: histogram_quantile at 0.50, 0.95, 0.99. High P99 on GET /api/shipments/nearby indicates slow geo-spatial queries against the location index.

panels.title: RabbitMQ Throughput — Order Events Consumed per Queue (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metrics: rabbitmq_published_total, rabbitmq_consumed_total | Layer 2 – Label: job=shipping-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: rate → sum by queue. Consumer lag on shipping.order-placed (published > consumed by > 100) means shipments are not being created fast enough — saga fan-out bottleneck.
